designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system crafts an immersive, contemplative, and ultra-secure atmosphere tailored for personal media vaults, encrypted archives, and confidential creative repositories. Drawing inspiration from deep-sea oceanic trenches and the mesmerizing, self-illuminating phenomena of hadal-zone fauna, the aesthetic couples deep abyssal shadows with electric bioluminescent signaling.

The core visual language unites **Glassmorphism** and **Atmospheric Layering**:
- Surfaces emerge like submerged pressure-resistant hulls, utilizing translucent obsidian glass and deep oceanic stratification.
- Vital interactions and focal media elements glow with an ethereal aquamarine aura, evoking the feeling of uncovering hidden relics in pitch-black waters.
- Emotional cues telegraph profound privacy, supreme discretion, quiet luxury, and high-fidelity technological refinement. The experience feels tranquil yet intensely focused, preserving personal memories and confidential media within a protected subterranean sanctuary.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses an expansive 12-column fluid grid system paired with an 8pt architectural rhythm to generate a sense of unhurried atmospheric openness:

- **Desktop (1200px and up)**: 12-column fluid grid, 24px gutters, 48px outer page margin. Maximum container width capped at 1520px for media feed integrity. Masonry and fixed-aspect media tiles reflow fluidly from 4 to 6 columns.
- **Tablet (768px - 1199px)**: 8-column fluid grid, 20px gutters, 32px outer margin. Side navigation retracts into an oceanic docked rail with icon indicators.
- **Mobile (below 768px)**: 4-column layout with 16px gutters and 20px page margins. Thumb-reach bottom floating command bar replaces desktop header navigation. Media grids adapt to a 2-column or single-stream focal card format.

Spacing uses generous internal padding inside containers (`space-lg` to `space-xl`) to establish an acoustic "isolation" effect around confidential media items, echoing the sound-dampened solitude of the deep ocean.

## Elevation & Depth

Spatial layering mimics light descending into water depths, transitioning from pitch abyss (`#030c1a`) up to suspended pressurized glass planes:

- **Ground Level (Abyss)**: `#030c1a` canvas, completely light-absorbent.
- **Tier 1 (Submerged Vessels & Shelves)**: Background surfaces tinted with `#0b2545` at 40% opacity, paired with a 24px backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(24px)`) and a hairline outer rim of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`.
- **Tier 2 (Elevated Media Vault Containers & Drawers)**: Tinted `#0b2545` at 70% opacity, framed by a soft internal light gradient falling from top-left to bottom-right (`linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.12), rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.6))`).
- **Tier 3 (Modals, Overlays & Player Decks)**: 90% Midnight Navy backed by a dual drop-shadow structure:
  - Base Shadow: `0 24px 48px -12px rgba(1, 6, 15, 0.85)` for physical depth.
  - Bioluminescent Scatter: `0 0 32px -4px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.15)` for an otherworldly phosphorescent glow.
- **Interactive Focus & Active States**: Hovering or selecting an elevated element activates an intensified edge discharge (`box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.35), inset 0 0 0 1px #00f5d4`).

## Components

### Buttons & Interactive Triggers
- **Primary Bioluminescent Action**: Background filled with `#00f5d4`, text rendered in deep `#030c1a` (bold Manrope), radiating an ambient glow (`box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.45)`). On hover, the glow blooms (`0 0 28px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.65)`).
- **Secondary Ghost Action**: Translucent Midnight surface (`rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.6)`), hairline border (`rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.25)`), text in `#00f5d4`. On hover, the border brightens to 100% aquamarine with subtle interior cyan tinting.
- **Destructive Vault Purge**: Deep obsidian base with an ominous crimson bioluminescent pulse (`#ff2a5f`), alerting the user to permanent file shredding.

### Media Cards & Vault Containers
- Built with Tier 1 frosted glassmorphism. Thumbnails are recessed with an ultra-subtle inward oceanic vignette.
- Metadata bar sits anchored at the base, displaying title in Sora and technical specs (resolution, duration, encryption key) in JetBrains Mono.
- Hover reveals an animated cyan scanline shimmer passing diagonally across the card face.

### Chips & Status Beacons
- Monospaced capsule tags with a leading 6px glowing dot.
- Active encrypted status displays a rhythmic pulsing dot with `animation: pulse 2s infinite ease-in-out` using `#00f5d4`.
- Quarantined or locked files utilize `#ff9f1c` (deep amber) or `#ff2a5f` (hadal red).

### Input Fields & Search Bars
- Recessed abyss background (`#020812`) framed with a 1px border of `rgba(148, 174, 203, 0.15)`.
- Input text rendered in pure luminous white (`#f0f9ff`) with placeholder in muted deep ocean slate (`#577494`).
- On focus, input triggers an immediate aquamarine edge ignition (`border-color: #00f5d4`) coupled with an ambient outer glow (`box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.2)`).

### Selection Controls (Checkboxes & Radios)
- Checkboxes: 20px rounded squares (4px radius) in dark navy with a 1.5px border. Checked state transitions instantly to solid `#00f5d4` with an abyss-black check icon and localized glow.
- Radios: Concentric circular beacons. When active, an inner 8px aquamarine disc radiates inside a midnight navy well.

### Vault-Specific Components
- **Bioluminescent Audio/Video Scrubber**: Track background in `#0b2545` with played buffer rendered as a brilliant `#00f5d4` glowing light beam; scrub thumb floats as an intense luminescent droplet.
- **Encryption Shield Bar**: Segmented progress indicator tracking real-time cryptographic integrity, each completed segment lighting up sequentially in cyan.
- **Biometric Unlock Portal**: Centerpiece auth trigger framed by concentric pulse rings expanding into the surrounding abyss.

- **10% Bioluminescent Aquamarine (`#00f5d4`)**: The concentrated pulse. Reserved strictly for primary call-to-actions, active playback or encryption progress, focus rings, and glowing indicator beacons. It must never be overused, ensuring its presence commands absolute visual priority.
- **Accent Radiance (`#00bbf9`)**: A secondary electric cyan used for secondary data markers, audio visualizers, and gentle gradient transitions into the core aquamarine.
- **Functional Alpha Overlays**:
  - Vault Surface Glass: `rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.45)` with dynamic backdrop blur.
  - Luminescent Glow Tint: `rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.18)` for ambient radial underlays beneath high-priority cards.
  - Text Hierarchy: Primary text at `rgba(240, 249, 255, 0.95)`, secondary labels at `rgba(148, 174, 203, 0.70)`, and muted timestamps/metadata at `rgba(87, 116, 148, 0.50)`.

- **Labels & System Meta (JetBrains Mono)**: Infuses the vault with an unmistakable cryptographic feel. Used for hashes, timestamps, encryption levels, file sizes, and status chips, evoking an authentic command-line precision behind a polished interface.
